text:
Anika: Quick sync — we need to lock the pilot acceptance matrix for the Optimize toolkit (batching/caching/quant recs + eval-triggered alerts). Proposing a very narrow MVP so we can ship a pilot to 3 customers next month.

Anika: MVP proposal (short):
- Per-route batching guidance: sample heuristics + config suggestion (not automated changes).
- KV/prefix cache suggestion: detect hot prefixes and recommend TTLs.
- Quantization recommendations: identify which models are safe for int8/ptq per family, with fallback guidance.
- Eval-triggered alerts: run prompt-set evals daily, alert on >5% regression in key metrics (accuracy/fluency) per customer.

Tom: Clarifying q: "recommendations" = UI only or API + one-click? we should be explicit for rollout.

Anika: UI-first, API endpoints for machine consumption later. One-click apply is out of scope for MVP (too risky).

Lena: From eval side — 5% is aggressive for some NLU tasks. Suggest metric-by-metric thresholds:
- generation: perplexity delta > 6% || ROUGE/L higher delta > 4%
- classification-like evals: accuracy drop > 3%
Also need a minimum sample size of 200 prompts to avoid noisy alerts.

Kai: Customer ask: enterprise pilots want an opt-in auto-quant path. If we say UI-only, they'll push for one-click. Can we include a gated "opt-in auto-apply" flag for Dedicated customers later?

Anika: Yes — add gated/out-of-scope note for MVP: "opt-in auto-apply reserved for Dedicated + opt-in policy". Keep pilot limited to recommendations + exported config.

Tom: Implementation notes from runtime perspective:
- Batching suggestions: we can infer preferred max_batch_size and target_latency from sampled traces. Need a small job to summarize traces per route.
- Cache detection: look for repeated prefixes within a 24h window; recommend prefix TTLs (10s/60s/300s) buckets.
- Quantization: we need a per-model quick-safety check (sample generation + eval) — ~30m per model on a small GPU.

Lena: I'll own the safety checklist for quantization and the evaluation harness for alerts. Need a small labeled prompt-set per pilot customer (we can seed with 1k prompts total).

devex-bot: ````json
{
  "alert_rule": {
    "name": "eval_regression_v1",
    "metric": "accuracy",
    "threshold": -0.03,
    "min_samples": 200,
    "notify": ["#pilot-alerts", "anika@redwood.io"]
  }
}
````

Tom: Ops question — what's the rollout plan for the pilot? Do we do one customer at a time or parallel 3? Parallel is desirable but increases support load.

Kai: Recommend staggered: start with 1 customer (low-risk), then add 2 more after 2 weeks if no regressions or issues.

Anika: Proposed acceptance criteria for pilot MVP (short checklist):
- Feature parity: batching recs, cache recs, quant recs (for 2 model families) delivered in UI + exportable JSON.
- Eval alerts: daily runs, >200 samples, thresholding per metric, alert fires to pilot channel when triggered.
- UX: simple one-screen recommendations, clear "why" for each rec, action = export config.
- Stability: no production impact — suggestions must never auto-apply.
- Telemetry: event for each recommendation viewed, accepted export, and alert firing.

Tom: I can deliver the trace summarizer + export hook in 2 sprints if we narrow the model families (e.g., LLaMA-2-like and Mistral-like).

Lena: I'll finalize metric thresholds and build the eval runner. Need 5 days to prepare seeded prompt-sets (with Kai for customer examples).

Kai: I'll coordinate with Pilot Customer A to get prompt samples and confirm opt-in for non-auto apply.

Anika: Action items: @Tom implement trace summarizer + export endpoint (2 sprints), @Lena build eval runner + thresholds (5 days), @Kai gather prompt-sets + customer opt-ins (this week). I'll draft the pilot acceptance doc and run a short review Thurs.

Tom: :thumbsup: noted.

Lena: :ok_hand: will post thresholds doc to the product drive once ready.

Kai: Will ping customer A by EOD.

Anika: Thanks — this narrows scope enough to ship a meaningful pilot while keeping safety on. We'll reconvene Thurs 10:30 for signoff.
